prior_test_exposure: Round 1 aggregate test accuracy was already reported. No round-2 design, hyperparameter, ensemble or artifact selection may use test references, test predictions or test accuracy.
internal_stratification: number of correct candidates, grouped by question
neural_inputs: train-standardized normalized embeddings and 59 original features; context family additionally includes group-centered embeddings; clip standardized values to [-8,8]
inner_selection: For each family choose decay and epoch by mean hard-holdout accuracy across three seeds, then mean full-holdout accuracy; first declared configuration breaks ties.
official_validation: Refit only the selected configuration per family on all informative training groups; assess all three seeds and their score ensemble on official validation.
fusion_normalization: Each member's group-centered scores divided by a standard deviation fitted on informative training inputs only.
promotion_rule: Must strictly improve hard official-validation accuracy over frozen round 1; at the same fusion weight must not reduce hard internal-holdout accuracy relative to a round-1 model refitted without those holdout groups; at least two of three seed-specific fusions must improve hard official-validation accuracy (pairwise linear is deterministic and uses one comparison). Rank eligible candidates by hard official-validation accuracy, then overall accuracy, then fewer inference bytes.
test_policy: Select, verify and freeze the full artifact before a single final test prediction/scoring. Do not switch back to round 1 based on test performance. If no method is promoted, retain round 1 and do not rescore test.
